instruction: Make a backup copy of the Mount Kilimanjaro photo from my Pictures directory to my Desktop, keeping the same filename.

result.command: python3 -c "from PIL import Image; import hashlib; import os; img_path = '/home/user/Desktop/picture1.jpg'; print(hashlib.sha256(Image.open(img_path).tobytes()).hexdigest() if os.path.exists(img_path) else 'NOT_FOUND')"
